planned_anchors.what_is_missing: QymCAD's status is one String that the next message overwrites: there is no severity, no acknowledgement and no history, so a failure is lost as soon as anything else is said. Its report_problem::ReportDraft is a document the user composes, not a surface. OM9 keeps the threading idea (the operation tells the surface what happened) and adds severity, an explicit acknowledgement and a bounded tail.
A 'bar across the bottom: the status line' slot exists as a KIND. The shell decides nothing about its content, severity or lifetime.
No status or error surface at all.
